summary: C27 audits every enabled local surface and binds it to an exact executable proof. The new 16-row security matrix and threat model cover the web shell, four read APIs, incident triage write, engine loopback HTTP, mTLS identity, update authority, certificate rotation, decoy isolation/provider ownership, storage/index integrity, retention and CLI file authority, JSON import and stored rendering. A real-browser suite proves shipped CSP enforcement, traversal confinement, forbidden Host/Origin rejection, disabled surfaces, strict triage media/key/body/object/replay rejection with byte-identical segments, idempotent replay and inert stored content at 360px. No critical or high finding remains in the local single-operator profile; four low observations are recorded. 20 browser tests, 82 Node tests, 192 engine anchors and 6 Python tests passed locally.
hosted_actions_note: Not run for this source. No push or publication occurred; remote workflow status is unverified.
scope_limits: Local Linux single-operator profile only; the matrix is not a penetration-test certification, no-vulnerability claim or resistance to OS compromise or a same-account malicious local user.
No public ingress or hosted multi-tenant authorization was tested; read APIs rely on loopback binding plus Host/Origin checks and carry no per-request authentication.
CSP retains style-src 'unsafe-inline' for the existing inline accent style and does not set COOP/CORP; both are documented low observations.
The triage browser fixture seeds incidents through the existing C22 synthetic generator; no real incident data was used.
Browser evidence is Chromium through the repository Playwright configuration only.
No production code, schema, migration, .env, Dockerfile, dependency or storage format changed.
C28 measurements, full C30 restart/restore and C40 release remain pending.

local_environment.notes: The machine's go env sets GOSUMDB=off, so engine-spawning Node tests require the documented GOSUMDB=sum.golang.org GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.27.2 environment. The failed first npm check is retained in docs/evidence/C26/npm-check-missing-env.log; the same command passed with the documented environment.
